source.name: Pasted text.txt
source.clock: Displayed clock; no date or UTC offset in attachment.

methods.tuple_key: casefold(process), PID, local address, local port, remote address, remote port; state excluded from identity and retained as an observed field; process start unavailable in attachment
methods.exclude: State Bound AND remote_address=0.0.0.0 AND remote_port=0
methods.burst: At each retained NEW timestamp t: count unique tuples for same process/PID and endpoint in closed interval [t-3s,t]; threshold >=5
methods.fanout: At each retained NEW timestamp t: count distinct remote IP:port for same process/PID in closed interval [t-30s,t]; threshold >=3
methods.nearest_marker: Minimize absolute displayed-time difference; signed offset=event time-marker time; earlier marker wins any tie
methods.alert_audit: Use displayed alert timestamp and preceding retained NEW rows; Analyze-NewConnection timestamps are not available
methods.overlap: Rolling windows overlap; counts must not be summed as independent events
